brief:
Israeli airstrikes killed at least five people across the Gaza Strip in recent days, Al Jazeera English reported. The strikes represent a significant escalation of military operations in the territory following a US-brokered ceasefire agreement that was intended to halt hostilities between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups.

The deaths occurred despite the ceasefire arrangement, which has failed to prevent continued Israeli bombing campaigns. Residents across multiple areas of Gaza faced renewed attacks as military operations intensified rather than subsided following the diplomatic agreement.
dek: Israel escalates its attacks across the Gaza Strip in recent days despite a US-brokered 'ceasefire'.
title: Israeli airstrikes kill at least five across Gaza strip
